headline: NetRise Extends Provenance to Developer Workflows, Stopping Malicious Packages Before They Reach The Build Pipeline
summary: NetRise®, the software supply chain security company that exists to eliminate blind trust in software, today announced enhancements to NetRise Provenance®, bringing package trust enforcement into the developer workflow via Visual Studio Code, the command line, and AI coding assistants. The release enables organizations to detect and block malicious or policy-violating open source packages before they enter software projects.
